title: Operator Certification & Release Orbit — Private (VPC/On‑Prem) RBAC / Audit / KMS Launch
creator: Maya Singh
description: This ticket coordinates the operator enablement kit, certification track, and consolidated release notes for the VPC / on‑prem launch of RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integrations. Goal: ensure customers and operator teams can validate, install, and upgrade with minimal friction and that release communications (public release notes, tenant migration notes, and partner briefings) are synchronized across PM, Eng, Design, Support, and GTM.
acceptance_criteria:
- Operator Playbook published to Confluence with runbook steps for install, rollback, upgrade, and troubleshooting.
- Release notes drafted and approved by Eng & Security with migration guidance and known limitations.
- Three training sessions scheduled: Operator Certification live session, Recording and self-study lab created.
- Support runbook with escalations and 2 canned tracer queries added to observability docs.
- Customer pilot cohort (5 customers) onboarded and provided feedback confirming steps work end-to-end.
plan: 1) Lock scope with Eng: RBAC role mapping format, audit log schema v1, KMS key rotation story. 2) Draft release notes and migration appendix; iterate with Security and DevRel. 3) Build operator training: slide deck, hands-on lab (GCE/VPC template), and quick-check checklist. 4) Run three rehearsals: internal operator run, pilot customer, and final go/no-go demo with stakeholders. 5) Publish release notes and enablement assets, schedule office hours for 2 weeks post-launch.
rollout_steps:
- Week -3: Finalize API response examples for RBAC & Audit (Owner: Eng - Priya).
- Week -2: Draft release notes and run internal review (Owner: PM - Maya).
- Week -1: Publish operator playbook to Confluence; create GH sample configs (Owner: Docs - Leah).
- D-1: Runcert with SRE/Support and capture checklist sign-off (Owner: Ops - Carlos).
- Launch Day: Publish release notes, update Console UI copy, trigger customer comms and partner digest (Owner: GTM - Anika).
- Post-launch Weeks 1-2: Host office hours and collect triage tickets, patch any critical issues (Owner: Support - Jamal).
release_notes_draft:
What’s new: RBAC (role templates + API), Audit Logs (structured JSON events, retention policy), KMS (customer-managed keys + rotation).
Admin impact: New roles require mapping for existing service accounts; RBAC will default to 'legacy-admin' mapping for 30 days.
Migration notes: Provide script to convert existing ACLs to RBAC templates; audit events may shift field names — see migration appendix.
Known limitations: Streaming audit events may delay under high throughput; KMS rotation currently requires a short 30s request pause for rolling keys.
Compatibility: Supported on Private v1.8+ with kernel-runtime 2.3+.

risks_mitigation:
- Risk: RBAC mappings break legacy automation. Mitigation: provide auto-migration script and 30-day compatibility mapping, include 'legacy-admin' rollback flag.
- Risk: Audit event schema changes break customer parsers. Mitigation: publish schema diffs and provide webhook sample adapters; offer a compatibility mode for 60 days.
- Risk: KMS rotation causes brief request failures. Mitigation: document recommended rotation window and instrument client retry guidance; SRE will run a canary key rotation during staging.
- Risk: Support load unexpected. Mitigation: pre-seed triage runbooks, dedicate 2 triage engineers week-of-launch.
